target_specification.label_semantics: Component passed 24h burn-in screening criteria but experienced wear-out or parametric degradation exceeding specification limits by 168h burn-in stress.
target_specification.criteria_disclaimer: Criteria are project-defined parametric screening limits for synthetic benchmark evaluation; NOT manufacturer datasheet limits and NOT externally flight/fab qualified.

trajectory_states.PASS_24H_PASS_168H: Healthy component passing both 24h screening and 168h qualification (latent_168h_failure = 0)
trajectory_states.PASS_24H_FAIL_168H: True latent defect: passed 24h screening but degraded past limits by 168h (latent_168h_failure = 1)
trajectory_states.FAIL_24H_FAIL_168H: Early failure visible at 24h screening; quarantined early (latent_168h_failure = 0)
trajectory_states.FAIL_24H_PASS_168H: Early 24h anomaly followed by normal 168h reading (latent_168h_failure = 0)
trajectory_states.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: Missing 24h or 168h telemetry; ground truth unknown (latent_168h_failure = null)
